items.t: GRI holds at 5.9% for a fourth year; UPS date moves to Dec. 21
items.body: UPS announced its 2027 GRI on Oct. 23, 2026: an average net 5.9%, effective Dec. 21, 2026. The effective dates of its GRIs were Dec. 22, 2025 (2026 GRI), Dec. 23, 2024 (2025 GRI), Dec. 26, 2023 (2024 GRI) and Dec. 27, 2022 (2023 GRI). FedEx announced its 2027 GRI on Sept. 18, 2026 (5.9%, effective Jan. 4, 2027), against announcement on Sept. 12, 2025 and effect on Jan. 5, 2026 for the 2026 GRI. Both carriers set 5.9% for 2024 through 2027, after 6.9% for 2023 and 4.9% for FedEx's 2018 GRI.

items.t: UPS fee lines rise faster than the 5.9% average; AHS weight to 50 lb
items.body: UPS's 2027 fee document, effective Dec. 21, 2026, shows most fees rising by a median of about 9%, against the 5.9% average net on rates. Residential Ground goes to $7.10 from $6.50; the 2026 GRI moved it from $6.10 to $6.50 and the 2022 GRI from $4.45 to $4.85. The Additional Handling minimum billable weight, introduced at 40 lb with the 2025 GRI, goes to 50 lb. FedEx's 2027 GRI lists a residential delivery charge moving from $6.95 to $7.35, service not specified in the source.

items.t: Fuel surcharges near 29%, against a 20% record in June 2025
items.body: On Oct. 26, 2026, UPS's fuel surcharge was 29.5% and FedEx's 29% at an average diesel price of $6.28. UPS's Ground table, posted Oct. 23 and effective Nov. 2, charges 0.50 point more than the old table at the same diesel price; FedEx tables effective Nov. 9 run from 30.00% to 31.50% for Ground. In June 2025, UPS and FedEx Ground both reached 20%, a record above FedEx's 19.50% in mid-2022. UPS also moved its extension thresholds from $4.99 to $5.80 for diesel and $3.01 to $3.56 for jet fuel in a Nov. 3 change with no effective date stated.

items.t: 2026 peak fees above 2025 and 2024 at FedEx and UPS
items.body: FedEx's 2026 peak window (Nov. 23 - Dec. 27) lists Ground residential at $0.80 (vs. $0.65 in 2025), Additional Handling at $11.85 (vs. $10.90) and Oversize at $117.25 (vs. $108.50). FedEx announced the 2026 charges on July 22, 2026, against July 8 in 2025. UPS's Large Package peak is $117.50, against $107 in 2025 and $99 in 2024; Over Maximum Limits is $590, against $540 and $495.

items.t: USPS stacks peak fees on an 8% temporary rise; fuel surcharge due
items.body: USPS announced a temporary 8% increase on parcel base postage on Mar. 25, 2026, in effect Apr. 26, 2026 to Jan. 17, 2027, and the 2026 peak surcharge (Oct. 4 - Jan. 17, 2027) sits on top of it. For Priority Mail and Ground Advantage in Zones 1-4, 0-3 lb, the peak add-on is $0.50, against $0.40 in 2025 and $0.30 in 2024. USPS announced on Oct. 26, 2026 a weekly fuel surcharge on Ground Advantage, Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express and Parcel Select from January 2027; in 2021 USPS had noted no fuel surcharge. Other mid-year changes: Parcel Select +25% (July 2024), Priority Mail +6.3% (July 2025), Ground Advantage Commercial +11.8% (July 2026).

items.t: New in 2026: per-pound country fees, origin-ZIP charge, SBR fuel fee
items.body: In 2025 the per-pound fees in the almanac were international peak fees of $0.10 to $0.52 per lb. In 2026, FedEx set $0.50 (export) and $0.70 (import) per lb for Zone K from Mar. 5, UPS set $1.34 per lb for U.S.-Middle East from Mar. 22, and FedEx added Vietnam-origin imports at $0.36 and $0.27 per lb on Nov. 2. UPS announced on Oct. 23 an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers, effective Dec. 21, 2026 or later, with no amount published. UPS Small Business Rates also get a 5% fuel surcharge alongside +4.5%, about 9.7% combined before agreement terms.
